digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler runtime — Cloud/DataCenter backend initialization
propositions: _build_datacenter must assert non-secret scope readiness (base_url and jira.project non-empty) at build time via BackendEnvError, symmetrically with _build_cloud's assert_cloud_scope_ready placement, before any injected-transport early return.
A DataCenter backend must still compose and build without JIRA_PAT and without the jira extra import at build time, with PAT and network validation deferred to _LazyDataCenterClient.

assert_cloud_scope_ready's email-format JIRA_USER check and non-empty project requirement must be documented as deliberately stricter than legacy ambient assert_env_ready, capturing a canonical tightening rather than accidental drift.
DC build with empty base_url or empty jira.project must raise BackendEnvError with the specific missing field named before any client or transport initialization.
